title: Knowledge Article Resolution
story: As a requestor, I want the assistant to answer questions using existing knowledge resources, so that simple issues can be resolved without creating tickets.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I describe an issue that matches existing knowledge articles
acceptanceCriteria.then: it retrieves and displays answers from relevant knowledge articles

acceptanceCriteria.given: the assistant provides a knowledge-based answer
acceptanceCriteria.then: the source knowledge article is shown with the response

acceptanceCriteria.given: the user confirms the issue is resolved by a knowledge article
acceptanceCriteria.then: no ticket is created and the interaction is logged as a ticket deflection

acceptanceCriteria.given: no relevant knowledge exists or the issue remains unresolved
acceptanceCriteria.when: the assistant cannot resolve the issue
acceptanceCriteria.then: it offers ticket creation as the next step

edgeCases: Multiple knowledge articles match the query
Knowledge article is outdated or deprecated
User asks follow-up questions about the article
Article content is very long and complex
User explicitly requests ticket creation despite available knowledge
